brand_rules: Use plain, colloquial language and start with a concrete owner pain point.
Do not promise diagnosis, cure, or treatment outcomes.
For symptoms, recommend an in-person veterinary checkup instead of online diagnosis.
Do not use real customer names, real cases, real account data, or real medical records.
Prefer same-city, practical topics over generic pet trivia.
comment_questions: How do I know whether my cat needs a checkup this week?
Where is the clinic and how do I book?
What should I bring for a first vaccine visit?
My dog keeps scratching one ear. Should I come in?
How often should senior pets get health screening?
Can I ask about dental cleaning before booking?
What information should I prepare before the visit?
How long does a first checkup usually take?
What signs mean I should not wait?
data_notice: Fully synthetic demo data. The store, people, metrics, comments, and cases are fictional and must not be presented as real customer or medical records.

demo_store.name: PawCare Demo Clinic
demo_store.positioning: Same-city pet care content that helps owners decide when to book a checkup

historical_content.lesson: Anxiety-led hooks produced many booking and location questions.
historical_content.topic: Why a cat hides after moving to a new home

historical_content.lesson: Checklists worked when the first three seconds named a visible sign.
historical_content.topic: Three signs a dog may need a dental checkup

historical_content.lesson: Generic knowledge attracted views but almost no local customer intent.
Preparation content converted well because owners were close to booking.
historical_content.topic: What to prepare before a first vaccine visit

historical_content.lesson: Entertainment reached many viewers but did not create local demand.
historical_content.topic: Cute pet clips without a care question

learning_event.expected_agent_change: The topic agent should stop recommending generic pet trivia and prioritize preparation checklists and symptom-to-checkup guidance with safe medical wording.
learning_event.new_review_conclusion: Generic knowledge and entertainment content should be deprioritized; owner-anxiety and preparation-checklist topics create stronger local booking intent.
